records.description: Optical canopy reflectance. PROSPECT gives a leaf's reflectance and transmittance from its pigments, water and dry matter, and 4SAIL propagates that through a canopy of a given leaf area index and angle distribution over a soil background, for a stated sun and view geometry. Returns reflectance in the green, red, near infrared and shortwave infrared, and NDVI. This is the optical counterpart of the microwave models: the same vegetated surface, a different kind of sensor.

records.description: Reference evapotranspiration from meteorology. Six published formulations of the same quantity, from the full Penman-Monteith energy balance down to temperature-only approximations. Use it when a question is about how much water leaves a surface, and choose the method deliberately: the formulations disagree, and each is entitled to a different set of inputs.

records.description: Catchment hydrology. Runs the PRMS process chain over the official Sagehen Creek test domain in the Sierra Nevada: solar geometry and atmosphere drive a canopy, a snowpack, a surface runoff scheme, a soil zone and a groundwater reservoir on daily time steps. Use it for how precipitation becomes snowpack, snowmelt, runoff and groundwater flow over a water year. It is the one registered model that is not microwave: where the others say what a surface would look like to a sensor, this one says what the water in it is doing. It ships in this package: numpy 2 and Python 3.12 or 3.13 are release requirements, not options.

records.description: Snow Microwave Radiative Transfer. Computes brightness temperature and backscatter from a homogeneous snow layer using a choice of electromagnetic theory and microstructure representation. Documented by the smrt-v1 paper in the literature corpus.

records.description: Passive microwave emission of a vegetated soil surface. A soil dielectric mixing model feeds Fresnel reflectivity with an h-Q roughness correction, and a single vegetation layer attenuates and emits according to its optical depth and single scattering albedo. This is the standard forward operator behind L-band soil moisture retrieval. Documented by the cmem-sampling-density paper in the literature corpus.

records.description: Active microwave backscatter from a vegetated soil surface. The canopy is treated as a cloud of identical water droplets that both scatters and attenuates, and the soil contribution is a linear function of soil moisture in decibels. This is the active counterpart of tau_omega and is what Sentinel-1 soil moisture work calibrates. Documented by the backscatter-forward-operator paper in the literature corpus.
